assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
SilverBridge Advantage is the payer that issued the denial.
The payer states precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations.
Palpitations correspond to diagnosis code R00.2.
The note documents episodes of dizziness.
Dizziness corresponds to diagnosis code R42.
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency corresponds to diagnosis code I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data.
The monitoring was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The payer's notice requested justification/supporting clinical documentation for the service.
